title: Late Winter, the Sun Stretches Warm

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a sunny, pleasant day—the winter chill was easing,
bringing with it the gentle anticipation of spring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Tracen Academy student was gazing idly up at the sky.
Assuming she was just basking in the sun, I quietly walked past, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ............Hooowaaah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
............Oh, good day~. Please, have a seat next to me.
You can see it quite clearly from this spot~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Look closely at the very top of that withered tree over there.
Do you see that single little leaf clinging on?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is swaying so gently all by itself~.
It looks as though it might fall, yet it refuses to fall at all~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She quietly looked back up at the withered tree...
Hesitant to leave her like this, I decided to keep watch over the leaf with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The withered leaf swayed gently in the breeze. Despite looking
frail enough to blow away any second, it held on tightly and showed no sign of dropping...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...What a strong little one~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, a reply...?
...Why, were you still here with me~?
choice_data_list: I got curious about the leaf...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...And so you stayed to watch it with me?
...My.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Bright! There you are, I've been looking everywhere for you...!
...Wait, who's this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is this person... someone you know...?
...Don't tell me they were bothering you—
choice_data_list: I'm a trainer here at Tracen Academy...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, you really are. You've got the badge and everything.
You startled me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Figuring she was in good hands now that her friend had arrived,
I quietly excused myself from the scene.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A trainer...
...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks after that encounter, I spotted her on campus again.
She was gazing blankly at the sky once more... A remarkably easygoing girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Provisional Trainer!
Good day to you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have been looking for you~.
I had a feeling we would cross paths again someday~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The weather is simply delightful today~.
It has been a long winter again... but surely spring is just around the corner, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, they have started replanting the flower beds.
I imagine so many lovely flowers will bloom beautifully~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What kinds of flowers do you like, Provisional Trainer?
As for myself... I quite adore small flowers huddled together in clusters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I do not know their names, but whenever I see them,
I think, 'What dear friends they are~,' and it warms my heart so~. Ufufu~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~... Oh, look up there.
Even in the sky, friendly little clouds are gathering together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she showed no sign of getting to the point...
Before long, her soft, tranquil aura had completely put me at ease...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that reminds me~. Regarding my training~.
Would you be so kind as to oversee it starting today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
~♪
Well then, shall we head over?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, before you observe my run...
First, some stretches. One, two, uup~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had agreed to oversee her training...!
But that wasn't the only surprise...

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wait... isn't that Mejiro Bright?!
The new generation of the prestigious Mejiro family, following right after McQueen and the others...!
choice_data_list: (She's an umamusume of the Mejiro family?!)
(She's an umamusume of the Mejiro family?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family—a prestigious bloodline that has produced countless elite horsegirls.
Even recently, barely a day goes by without seeing their names in the headlines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall go run 1,800 meters now~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright, a daughter of the renowned Mejiro line.
Though I'd gotten swept up in her pace, my curiosity got the better of me, and I agreed to watch her run. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Heeeyaaah~.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...?! She's so slow out of the gate...!
...And she's not even accelerating... Are you kidding me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho~... Oh my? Temporary Trainer-sama?
Ahhh~, have I crossed the finish line already?

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...T-This is... Her late kick doesn't have much punch either.
Mejiro name or not... yeah, I think I'll pass...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her run certainly left plenty of room for improvement. However,
she maintained a remarkably sustained drive after turning the fourth corner. What's more...
choice_data_list: (It looked like she still had plenty left in the tank...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What did you think~? I truly wish to run in the Debut Selection Race...
Would you be so kind as to oversee my running until then~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her run gave me the sense that I might uncover the key to her growth.
Above all, leaving her to run all on her own felt too worrying...
choice_data_list: All right. I'll coach you until the Debut Selection Race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. I have already registered for the next race,
so I look forward to working with you until then.
choice_data_list: ...Wait, the next one? That's next week!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, is that so? Then first, we must have a tea party~.
Chatting over black tea is the finest way to know someone's character~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, quite abruptly, I ended up training Mejiro Bright
in the single week leading up to the Debut Selection Race...!
